name: Coventry University
description: Coventry University is a public university in the centre of Coventry in the English Midlands, which gained university status in 1992 and traces its origins to the Coventry School of Design founded in 1843. It has one of the largest international student populations in the UK.
whyIncluded: Coventry University has partnered PSB Academy since 2014, so you can earn a Coventry degree in Singapore in business, engineering, computing or cyber security.

livingCosts.summary: Coventry University's minimum monthly guide for one international student (food, phone, clothes, leisure, books, going out, travel) combined with its 2026/27 en-suite hall rent, bills included. Childcare and the TV licence are left out.
livingCosts.notes: Rung A (two Coventry University pages). Food, transport and personal from the international 'Living in the UK' page ('approximate guide to the minimum amount you should expect for living expenses in the UK per month'): food 150-200 -> midpoint 175; travel/transport 32 (96 per term); personal = mobile 30 + clothes/shoes 30 + leisure/sport 25 + books/stationery 20 + socialising 100 = 205. That page is undated and its private rent (300-400 + bills 30-50) and TV licence (145.50) look several years old, so housing is taken instead from the university's 'Accommodation fees' page for 2026/27: Bishop Gate / Godiva Place undergraduate en-suite GBP 162/week on a 43-week contract, bills included, converted at 52/12 = 702.00/month; months = 10 (43 weeks is 9.9 months). Excluded: childcare (500), TV licence (12/month), one-off costs. No monthly or yearly total is stated by the university.

programmes.name: BSc (Hons) Computer Science
programmes.summary: Yearly tuition for international students starting in 2026. Coventry may raise fees each year by up to 5% above inflation, so later years could cost more.
programmes.notes: Coventry University course page 'MSci/BSc (Hons) Computer Science' (fetched 2026-10-07), year of entry 2026-27: International £20,800 per year (2027/28 fees TBC); 3-year full-time route. An optional professional placement or study abroad year costs an extra £1,900 for international students (not included). Coventry course pages say that for international students 'we may increase fees annually, but such increases will be no more than 5% above the inflation rate', so cohortLocked is false. No separate compulsory fees. No 2025 or 2024 row: the course pages show only 2026-27 (2027/28 fees TBC) and no earlier official figure was found. 2025 row (2026-10-13, unofficial): epi-integration.coventry.ac.uk, a Coventry-hosted integration/staging copy of the course page that still carries 2025-26 entry content, states International £19,850 per year (years of entry 2025-26 and 2026-27, only start date January 2026, UK fee £9,535 = the 2025/26 UK rate, placement fee quoted for placements starting 2027/28); marked secondary because it is not the live public site. 2024 still unfilled: no 2024-25 copy of the page or year-dated third-party figure was found. Round 4 (2026-10-13): the epi-integration fees hub gives only a September 2025 range and ApplyBoard/TheRightU give undated figures; still unfilled. Round 5 (2026-10-13): the live course page's year selector (?term=2024-25) and the epi-integration and epi-preprod copies (epi-preprod shows 2026-27/2027-28) serve no 2024-25 entry; Coventry's international fees page and ApplyBoard/Yocket give only a September 2024 range (£16,800-£20,050), not a course figure, so 2024 is still unfilled. Round 6 (2026-10-13): the course page fee table is server-rendered with no fee API (network log), and WebSearch found no dated 2024/25 course figure or Coventry fee PDF (aggregators such as TopUniversities, Yocket and Azent give undated figures); 2024 still unfilled.
